LCSC C59461. Buzzer reservoir: supplies the 4 kHz coil pulses locally (about 10 uF effective at 3 V). v0.5.2: moved >= 1.5 mm from the board edge.
LCSC C1525. Buzzer gate coupling capacitor. With R45: tau 6.8 ms.
LCSC C36871. Gate return to the Q4 source: Q4 is off 14 ms typ / 32 ms worst simulated corner after GPIO8 stops toggling.

LCSC C8522 (JSCJ). Gate clamp / DC restore: anode gate, cathode Q4 source. Low-Vf Schottky is required: a 1N4148 clamp leaves Q4 with only -2.39 V of gate drive at 2 kHz / 90 % (below the 2.5 V Rds(on) spec point).

LCSC C132016. 3V3 supervisor, 2.93 V threshold, open drain, 200 ms typ delay. Pulls the reset RC node low (through R46), never ESP_EN: U8 drives ESP_EN push-pull. v0.5.4: group moved from the top-left strip (now the LED bar) to the right side.

LCSC C11702. Limits the C9 discharge current into the U12 open-drain output to 3.3 mA; low level 69 mV, discharge tau 1 ms. v0.5.4: group moved from the top-left strip (now the LED bar) to the right side.

LCSC C2921739 (Nidec Components CUS-12TB, 1 508 JLC stock 2026-11-13). Side-actuated SPDT slide switch, knob 1.5 mm out of the body, 1.5 mm travel. Datasheet "Contact timing: Non-shorting" (break-before-make): SOURCE_QUALIFIED can never meet 3V3. 10 000 cycles at 4 V / 300 mA; -20..+70 C. Common pin 2 = POWER_PERMIT; knob toward pin 3 = RUN (SOURCE_QUALIFIED), toward pin 1 = SVC (3V3). While the knob moves, POWER_PERMIT floats and R30 pulls it low: switching always resets the ESP32.

LCSC C7843. LED data level shifter: VCCA 3V3 (A input VIH 2.0 V at VCCA 3.0-3.6 V; ESP32-C3 VOH >= 2.64 V), VCCB = VSYS (1.65-5.5 V, specified over the whole 3.9-4.5 V VSYS range, unlike 74AHCT which needs >= 4.5 V); B VOH >= VCCB - 0.1 V against the LED VIH 0.55 x VDD. DIR tied to VCCA (A to B). Ioff / VCC isolation: B is high-Z while 3V3 is off, R50 keeps DIN low.
LCSC C1525 (basic). U13 VCCA decoupling.
LCSC C1525 (basic). U13 VCCB decoupling.
LCSC C25118. Series damping at the ESP32 GPIO1 for the long data run to U13.
LCSC C25741 (basic). Holds the U13 A input low while GPIO1 is high-Z (reset, ROM boot).
LCSC C25741 (basic). First-DIN pulldown: the bar stays dark during boot and while U13 is unpowered (B high-Z).
